nodes.title: 02 / Image to copy / pose, outfit, scene
Generated prompt
widgets_values: A casual smartphone-style poolside photograph shows an adult woman seated at the edge of a swimming pool in warm low sunlight. She has long dark brown hair, a warm tan complexion, almond-shaped eyes, defined brows, a straight nose, full lips, and a small nose stud. Her pose is relaxed and intimate: she leans forward with her torso angled toward the camera, head slightly tilted, both arms raised, and hands gathering her hair near the crown. She looks directly into the lens with a calm expression and a slight closed-mouth smile. She wears a leopard-print string bikini with a triangular halter top and side-tie bottoms, along with silver necklaces, a bracelet, and small earrings. The framing is a close three-quarter crop from the thighs upward, placing her prominently in the foreground while the pool water sits behind her. In the background, a bamboo fence runs horizontally across the scene, with sea, boats, cliffs, and white buildings softly visible beyond it. The lighting comes from the left, creating bright highlights on skin and water, gentle shadows, and a slightly hazy coastal atmosphere.
